title: React application boundary handles rejected lazy modules
claim: A rejected lazy route module can leave the SPA without a usable recovery path.
classification: recovery boundary already implemented; missing focused lazy-import regression is now covered

implementation_review.behavior: React render/import errors show an accessible alert and a user-triggered reload action; no automatic reload loop or remote error telemetry is used.

tests.command: npm exec --yes --package=node@22 -- npm run test --workspace=@oneirodex/ui -- src/AppErrorBoundary.test.tsx
tests.coverage: render exception and rejected lazy module import show safe alert and invoke manual reload

tests.command: npm exec --yes --package=node@22 -- npm run test --workspace=member-app -- src/components/RelatedMediaStrip.test.tsx
tests.coverage: dialog focus entry, Tab/Shift+Tab trap, Escape close, and launcher focus restoration

verification.format_check: Prettier passed after formatting the focused regression

limits: The rejected lazy module is simulated in Vitest; this is not a browser deployment test against a removed hashed chunk.
VoiceOver and NVDA smoke remain open for the related-media modal.
